text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Fan Appreciation Festival. A festival 
of sports held by inviting fans onto the 
Tracen Academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Racing is important, but festivals are 
important too! We've gotta enjoy 
celebrations to the fullest☆"
choice_data_list: Which event is Ricky competing in?
Which event is Ricky participating in?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Um, speaking of sports that go well with 
feng shui—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, what Copano Rickey chose was—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickeyâ Luckyâ Cheer Squad!! Let's 
lead our allies to victory with feng shui 
cheerleading!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she chose to participate in 
cheering rather than competing. In that 
case, the friends cheering alongside her 
are...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be you guys look like you 
need our help?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Very well, Rickey-san. If you're going to 
take this seriously, then I must teach you 
the mindset of a first-rate cheerleader...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry about that, Nature, King. Feng 
shui cheer isn't really like that, though.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's not about encouragement— it's about 
completely dominating the track on your 
own.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: So the two helping us out are these two!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um... What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: A cheer squad? Is that super marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the left is Manhattan Cafe. She's a 
mysterious Umamusume rumored to be 
possessed by something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the right is Marvelous Sunday. An 
umamusume who loves everything marvelous, 
and ultimately turns everything into 
something marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm, if I take charge of the situation 
and position these two effectively—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"There isn't a single match we can't win! 
So, will you take your position just as I 
say?"

text_block_list.name: Cafe & Marvelous
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Yep! ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the soccer match began, but—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"First, the "Wind" [Son]. We position 
Manhattan Cafe to the southeast, behind 
our team's goal."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"The other team's player is... 
approaching? If they score a goal right 
here..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—I won't... forgive you. I... won't... 
forgive you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ( R O O O O A R ! )

text_block_list.name: Opposing Team's Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is that?! Oh, crap...!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And then, 'Qian' [Heaven]. To the 
northwest, near the opponent's goal, we 
place Marvelous Sunday-chan.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Beep, beep, beep☆ Beep, beep, beep♪ 
Something feels so totally Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Shoot, shoot, marvelous! Bang, bang, goal, 
MARVELOUS!!!!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, feels like it's gonna go in! When 
you get a chance, shoot, shoot, shoot!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—Yin and Yang. When two poles are created 
on the field, a flow forms there. That is 
to say...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Flows of advantage and disadvantage are 
created. This is the home-and-away theory. 
And—

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text: (TWEEET!) Game over!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: We did it...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous☆ Marvelous♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The score difference was small. But there 
was an overwhelming gap in ball possession 
and shot attempts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, the power of Copano 
Rickey's feng shui. However...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Glad I managed to win safely~. 
Well then, shall we head somewhere else?"
choice_data_list:
Aren't you going to join the victory 
circle?

Aren't you going to join the victory 
circle?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There's no way we'd join in~. On the 
surface, we're supposed to have had 
nothing to do with it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui cheerleaders work behind the 
scenes. We're completely satisfied with 
that. Right?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I... suppose so. Maybe that's just how it 
is.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't quite put my finger on it, 
but they were a cool-looking bunch. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now then, to wrap up the Thanksgiving 
festival, maybe I should enter something 
too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Come on, who wouldn't want to win using 
feng shui power and get fawned over just a 
little?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Since this is the only program left, 
let's do thiiis☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Copano Rickey dove triumphantly 
into the pool, but—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? Come to think of it, when I was 
little, in the water...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I had a dream where I almost drowned... 
Ah, my leg is cr—ow, ow, ow, ouch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment she was distracted by past 
memories, trouble struck. As a competitor, 
Copano Rickey failed to achieve a good 
result.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At the after-party. Here, Copano Rickey 
couldn't remain just a shadow hero.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on! What's with this crowd of 
people!?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ricky-chan, please give me some Feng Shui 
power!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Could you do a Feng Shui reading for me 
too? Huh, wait, was it not fortune 
telling?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey, the Feng Shui Umamusume, 
had become famous through and through. She 
was so popular that she could barely even 
move...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? I might not be able to 
take on this many people at once.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, isn't there some good way to handle 
this...
choice_data_list: Can't we make everyone happy all at once?
Can't we make everyone happy all at once?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Make everyone happy all at once...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey pondered for a moment. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see! You're right! With this many 
people, we can do things we normally 
couldn't☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, everyone! Right now, all of us 
here are going to draw a 'Formation'!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The Happy Formation to invite good luck☆ 
I'll direct things from the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Copano Rickey dashed up to the 
rooftop, and—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Southwest team! More to the right! Just a 
little bit more...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, right there is great! And with that, 
our collective Grand Bagua drawing is 
complete☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Applause erupts. A picture of happiness 
that could never have been painted alone 
was born.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, this is sure to make everyone 
happy☆ And with that said—!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the Fan Appreciation 
Festival afterparty begins! Rickey☆ Lucky☆ 
Super Happy☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fireworks resounded in a spectacular 
display. And so, the Fan Appreciation 
Festival came to a delightful close.
